description: This PHP class defines the LeaveBalance component within the OrangeHRM system, representing an employee's leave entitlement, usage, and balance calculations, including configurable options for pending leave.

classes.name: LeaveBalance
classes.description: Represents an employee's leave entitlement, usage, scheduled leave, pending leave, taken leave, and the resulting balance, with support for date-specific calculations and configurable inclusion of pending leave.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the LeaveBalance with provided values for entitlement, used, scheduled, pending, and taken leave amounts.

methods.name: updateBalance
methods.description: Calculates and updates the leave balance based on entitlement, scheduled, taken, and optionally pending leave according to configuration.

methods.name: getBalance
methods.description: Returns the current calculated leave balance.

methods.name: getEntitled
methods.description: Retrieves the total entitled leave amount.

methods.name: setEntitled
methods.description: Sets the total entitled leave amount.

methods.name: getUsed
methods.description: Retrieves the amount of leave used.

methods.name: setUsed
methods.description: Sets the amount of leave used.

methods.name: getScheduled
methods.description: Retrieves the amount of scheduled leave.

methods.name: setScheduled
methods.description: Sets the amount of scheduled leave.

methods.name: getPending
methods.description: Retrieves the amount of pending leave.

methods.name: setPending
methods.description: Sets the amount of pending leave.

methods.name: getTaken
methods.description: Retrieves the amount of leave taken.

methods.name: setTaken
methods.description: Sets the amount of leave taken.

methods.name: getAsAtDate
methods.description: Gets the date at which the leave balance is ascertained.

methods.name: getYmdAsAtDate
methods.description: Returns the 'as at' date formatted as a YMD string.

methods.name: setAsAtDate
methods.description: Sets the date for which the leave balance calculation applies.

methods.name: getEndDate
methods.description: Gets the end date for the leave balance period.

methods.name: getYmdEndDate
methods.description: Returns the end date formatted as a YMD string.

methods.name: setEndDate
methods.description: Sets the end date for the leave balance period.
